comment: Explicit overrides: the index entry (Package, Version, Architecture) points its Filename at this GitHub release asset instead of debs/<file>. Read by scripts/override-filenames.py at build time. The asset must be the same file as debs/<file> (same size and SHA256), or the build fails. Everything not listed here stays on debs/. Currently one entry: a download test of 26Page 1.0.0.
